blocks.text: For SFO–BKK on January 15, these are three one-stop economy award options. My pick is the earliest-arriving of the shown choices:

The Aeroplan award via HKG arrives 35 minutes before the BR option below and is also 20 minutes shorter in elapsed time. Its downside: award pricing is incomplete, and the listed fees are in minor CAD units; the leg cabins are not specified.
blocks.label: Earliest arrival

blocks.text: A reasonable alternative if you prefer BR: it arrives 35 minutes after the Aeroplan/HKG itinerary and has one reported seat. The listed Aeroplan itinerary also reports one seat, but neither award’s full price is known.
blocks.label: BR via TPE

blocks.text: Also via TPE, this arrives 20 minutes after the other BR itinerary, with one reported seat. Choose it only if its unreported details suit you better; the packet gives no distinguishing benefit.
blocks.label: Later BR option

blocks.text: The Singapore Airlines cash itinerary is listed at USD 440 for one traveler, but the price scope is unknown, so it is not a confirmed like-for-like total against the awards. It has one stop via SIN and arrives earlier than all three awards, though it departs much earlier.
blocks.label: Cash context

blocks.text: Limitations: these are assembled source results, not confirmed or currently bookable itineraries. Award totals are incomplete, and seat counts do not establish availability at booking. Coverage was partial; verify current schedules, availability, and prices with the providers.
